recycled_content.source_quote: Nobufil PLAx CF is a sustainable 10% carbon fiber reinforced modified PLA made from recycled industrial waste sourced in Europe.
recycled_content.notes: The 10% in the quote is the carbon fibre share, not recycled content; no recycled percentage is published.

relative_claims.source_quote: This product is made from recycled plastic – approx. 60% of CO2 equivalents can be saved compared to raw materials from primary production.
relative_claims.notes: Datasheet says "approx." 60%; no study, method, boundary or unit published.
